title: API Design, Contracts, and Protocols
description: Design evolvable HTTP APIs and choose deliberately between REST, events, webhooks, GraphQL, and gRPC.
learningOutcomes: Choose an integration protocol from explicit tradeoffs

lessons.title: Resource Modeling and HTTP Semantics
lessons.description: Model resources, methods, status codes, and idempotency as a coherent contract.
learningObjectives: Apply safe and idempotent HTTP semantics

lessons.title: Versioning, Compatibility, and Deprecation
lessons.description: Change public contracts without surprising existing clients.

lessons.title: Caching, Concurrency, and Conditional Requests
lessons.description: Use HTTP validators and preconditions to reduce work and prevent lost updates.

lessons.title: Webhooks, Events, and Delivery Contracts
lessons.description: Build signed, retryable, observable event delivery at system boundaries.

lessons.title: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and Generated SDKs
lessons.description: Select a protocol and client strategy based on real constraints.
